purpose: QQQ/BIL action attribution before selecting a learning model
target_episode: Contiguous completed-close QQQ targets below 1; execution window starts the next open and ends at the open execution of the first full-target return, including that day's close. Open episodes are censored.
action_labels: At every actual noninitial QQQ trade, clone the account immediately before the open. Compare FOLLOW_BASE against HOLD (no trades) and HALF_ADJUST (halfway between actual pretrade weight and submitted target), then hold shares to the fixed horizon. For buys also compare FULL_REENTRY. No liquidation fee at the common terminal mark.
weekly_reentry_labels: First available session of each ISO week whose completed-close target is below 1 and actual stock weight below 0.999. Starting from those close holdings, buy at the next open, then hold shares for 21/63 sessions: HOLD, HALF_REENTRY, FULL_REENTRY; compare FOLLOW_BASE from the identical starting account.
measurement: Action labels start at the execution open, have H execution-session closes, and require all H future observations; unavailable labels are explicitly censored. Eligibility and episode membership use only information available at decision time.
attribution: Daily account changes split into overnight allocation, intraday allocation and friction against a matched initial buy-and-hold QQQ account. Initial entries match; subsequent contributions divided by that day's passive QQQ NAV telescope to terminal relative wealth.
limits: Fixed-horizon action labels are not a fitted or tradable timing strategy
Future original orders are followed only by the baseline comparator, not replayed onto a changed portfolio
Counterfactual one-shot policies intentionally hold through subsequent signals; deployment would require hard-guard-compatible closed-loop validation
Labels overlap and belong to a few market episodes; daily/weekly rows are not independent samples
Original periods have already been repeatedly examined
Old crisis CAPE and BIL histories are proxies
No parameter search or model training in this stage
